# netactuate_cloud_routing_router_vrfs (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Routing Router Vrfs visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_routing_router_vrfs" "example" {
  router_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) Cloud router ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vrfs` (List of Object) VRFs configured on the cloud router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs))

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `vrf_id` (Number)
